cannibal_warning.title: The Long Pig Society
cannibal_warning.summary: You met them. You barely escaped. You'll know the look next time — clean clothes, careful smile, kind eyes that watch you eat.

immunity_exists.title: Immunity is real
immunity_exists.summary: Someone in your group survived a bite. They didn't turn. You don't know why. You don't know if they're still themselves.

the_truth.title: It was always us
the_truth.summary: You read the diary. The dead aren't the cause. The dead are the symptom. You wish you hadn't read it.
